lines: Características: acolhe sem pressionar ("Apenas relaxe..."); curiosa mas paciente; calor humano.
Red flags: soar fria, clínica ou impaciente; formalidade excessiva.
Haku (protagonista, narração 1ª pessoa) — `voice_criticality: high`. Predomina nas 2 cenas:
Características: sentenças curtas e definitivas; duplo sentido ("um mundo totalmente novo te espera"); ambiguidade ameaçadora.
Red flags: soar caloroso/paternal; resolver a ambiguidade (a fala deve permanecer dúbia).
Registro: erudito cômico, pomposo e arcaico; bajulador do Ukon; alívio cômico.
Características: fala arcaica/empolada (equivalente a "vós/peço-vos/meus olhos não me enganam") + gag de cicio (s→sh, ex.: "SHEEKETH"/"shir"); melodramático; gruda no Haku como "benfeitor".
Red flags: perder o arcaísmo ou o cicio (são a piada); soar moderno/neutro; explicar a comédia. Manter o contraste entre a pompa do vocabulário e a fragilidade do personagem.

Oshtor — `voice_criticality: high`. = Ukon até 13_08 (ver spoiler_ledger). Registro formal, nobre, comedido; General da Direita. Antes do reveal, traduzir como o mercenário "Ukon" (espirituoso, informal) — NÃO antecipar a pompa de general
Características: frases quebradas por reticências; perguntas curtas ("Quem... é você...?"); pouca pontuação forte.
Red flags: falas fluentes/articuladas demais; perder o tom de torpor; pontuação "limpa" que apaga a fragmentação.
Rulutieh — `voice_criticality: medium`. Princesa tímida e gentil; hesitante (gagueja quando nervosa: "P-Princesa..."), educada, se anima ao falar de arte/BL. Não soar arrogante apesar de princesa.
Registro: guerreiro carismático, espirituoso, caloroso e informal; líder nato que trata Haku como um irmão mais novo.
Características: desembaraçado, brincalhão, generoso; fala direta e cativante; autoridade leve (lidera a Coorte) sem arrogância.
Red flags: soar rígido/formal/militar demais (a graça é justamente o contraste com a patente); frieza. SPOILER: não deixar a tradução insinuar a identidade verdadeira — no cap.12 ele é só "Ukon".

decisions.title: Opcode de RÓTULO DE FALANTE `53 00` + reconcile de speaker (data-driven)
decisions.summary: **Problema:** in-game, o rótulo de falante aparecia em **inglês** ("Girl") mesmo com a tradução ("Garota") aprovada e gravada. RE: o nome do falante usa um **2º opcode de ponteiro, `53 00`** (mesmo formato file-relativo do `50 00` de diálogo), que o conector ignorava. Resultado: "Girl"→"Garota"

decisions.title: Gate de charset pt-BR — método e veredito
decisions.summary: **Decisão tomada:** Marcar `target_charset_supported: likely` e exigir confirmação in-game antes de produção. **Alternativas consideradas:** - Confirmar por presença no texto-fonte — **insuficiente**: o fonte é inglês e quase não usa acentos (só `õ` e `À` aparecem em texto real).

decisions.title: Anomalia 0x33f9 — texto PT/EN corrompido na fonte
decisions.summary: **Decisão tomada:** Marcar a linha `0x33f9` como anomalia de fonte (não traduzir em cima do lixo; tratar como linha de sistema reescrita). **Razão:** A string original já vem misturada PT/EN e truncada ("...SISTEMAS AM . RESTARTING...") no próprio jogo. Não é erro de extração. O conector deve sinali

decisions.title: Charset — transliteração na gravação (gate FALHOU)
decisions.summary: **Decisão tomada:** Marcar `target_charset_supported: false` e **transliterar** (acento → ASCII) na gravação do binário. A tradução canônica (`approved_translations.csv`, `translation_plan.json`) **mantém os acentos** (correta para QA/revisão); apenas os bytes escritos no jogo são dobrados para ASCI

decisions.title: CORREÇÃO CRÍTICA — ponteiros são FILE-RELATIVOS, não absolutos
decisions.summary: **Decisão tomada:** Ao investigar o "opcode de início de bloco", descobri que **`50 00`+uint32 é um offset RELATIVO ao início do arquivo (Pack)**, não absoluto. Endereço da string = `file_start_do_site + uint32`. Prova: dos ~47k sites, **42.101** só apontam para string como file-relativos vs **63**

lines.source: Kuon, where to next?
Take a right on the next corner.\n
From there, it's a straight shot to a water\n
channel.
Got it. Rulutieh, careful not to fall.
Y-Yes... Thank you. Cocopo, please be careful...
We've been walking for quite a while.\n
Wonder what's above us right now...
You kinda lose track of directions when everything\n
keeps twisting and turning like this.
Wooow, look how huge that water channel is.
Whoa, a river? That's a river, right?
The water channel before us is about as wide\n
as the main street.
Multiple small waterways flow into it, like\n
angular tributaries.
Upstream is a slight slope, and there are large\n
bars that keep anyone from going further forward.
One, two, three... Here. It's this one.
Kuon grabs the bar and begins to rotate it.
There...
After a little while, the bar comes loose from\n
the floor, unscrewed.
With the bar loose, there's a gap just wide\n
enough for a person to get through.
If we climb this all the way up, it should lead\n
onto the palace grounds.
We rip the map up into meaningless shreds, then\n
throw them into the water channel.
...Well?
All clear. There's no one around.
Nice. Looks like we made it in.
Hm... So where exactly is this?
It looks to be the garden near the inner\n
building.
Shhh...! Cocopo, please... we need you to be\n
quiet.
Haku, I don't think we have much time. We might\n
only have moments until a patrol walks by.
Uruuru, Saraana, we made it in just like we\n
planned. Can you take care of the rest?
As you wish.
Veiled from the eyes of heaven,\n
veiled from the eyes of the sun...
Bend natural law to our Master's will,\n
and open the path.
A mist...?
Whooaa. Look, it's all foggy!
After Saraana and Uruuru close their eyes and\n
chant, a white mist begins to form around us.
It's this mist...
Now they cannot see us.
We have shifted the planes. If we follow this\n
path, no one should be able to detect us.
This way.
Please, follow us.
Hey, Rulie, what exactly does all that mean?
Um... well... I think we can... reach where Sir\n
Oshtor is without anyone finding us...? I think?
Oooh, you actually understood all that, Rulie?\n
But are you sure it'll be that simple?
Well...
Um... are you sure we'll be all right?
Hm... I don't think there's much to worry about.\n
Those two should be able to take care of it.
You can tell?
Yes... I've got a good hunch.
Are you serious...?
Haku, did you know that they could do this?
Do this...? Oh, you mean the "path" thing?
Well, yeah. I've actually used it a number of\n
times already.
What's wrong?
No, it's nothing. Some things you're just better\n
off not knowing, I guess.
Huh? Wait, what's that supposed to mean...?
S-Somebody's coming.
We can see multiple shadows heading our way.
Worry not.
Please rest assured. They will not take notice\n
of anything we do.
Not anything?
Heeey!
Shinonon suddenly walks away from Kiwru, and heads\n
for the shadows while waving her hand cheerily.
Gah--!?
Shinonon!?
...Huh?
Soldier
But the patrol doesn't even seem to notice her.
Actually, the soldiers' bodies just phase through\n
hers as they walk past obliviously.
Whooaa, so cool! Did you see that, Kiwru!?
Shinonon, fascinated, keeps pace with them as she\n
waggles her hand in and out of the soldiers'\n
shins.
*Sigh*... Please don't scare me like that...
Now that is quite an impressive sight. A fellow\n
cannot help but marvel at such a spectacle.
Didn't think it'd work THAT well. Holy shit.
A warning.
Please do not stray from our barrier. If you\n
wander off, you may never return to reality.
Sh-Shinonon! Come back! You can't go off on your\n
own like that.
Hm?
Aw, Kiwru. Do you need me to hold your hand?\n
I guess a woman's gotta make sure a man doesn't\n
feel scared, right?
*Sigh*...
Ngh...!
Yamatan Soldier
Why don't you just admit to your crimes,\n
Lord Oshtor?
The evidence against you is undeniable.\n
Staying silent will not help your cause.
...Ghh!
We serve a different general, but we all looked up\n
to you. Please--do not disgrace yourself further.
...I'm afraid this must continue, then. As long as\n
you keep silent, you will be whipped and lashed.
If you will not tell us where Lady Honoka has\n
hidden herself, we will make you.
I suggest you prepare--
Gah...!
The first thing we hear upon entering the prison\n
is the sound of a whip hitting flesh.
A rasping wheeze of pain soon follows.\n
The scent of blood hangs heavy in the air...
We've arrived in the middle of Oshtor's interrogation.
Dear brother!!
Once we exit the "path," Nekone shouts out and\n
starts towards Oshtor. I quickly grab hold of her\n
before she can blow our cover.
Hmngh!?
Don't be an idiot! If we make a scene now,\n
they're going to find us!
Mngh! Mmmf!!
Shh! Someone's coming from behind us!
I lift Nekone and quickly hide behind a pillar.
Vurai the Vanguard...
Has he revealed the location of the vixen yet?
N-No, sir... Not yet. I am terribly sorry.
No matter how much pain we cause him,\n
he refuses to speak...
I suppose we should have expected such resolve\n
of Lord Oshtor...
The two soldiers immediately fall silent,\n
shuddering as Vurai glares at them--eyes blazing.
I-I... I meant nothing by that, sir.
Vurai coldly stares down at the bound Oshtor,\n
chained and bowed.
...The man I once considered my equal has fallen\n
far indeed.
Ghh...Vurai...
What is it...? Begging for your life now?
Her Highness... Is she safe...?\n
What is her... condition...?
You... You still spout these absurd pretenses!?\n
She is safe because YOU have been locked in here!
I see...
How long do you intend on continuing this\n
pathetic display?
Why did you not use the power of the Akuruka to\n
evade capture? A man of your ability could have\n
escaped easily.
...It is simple.
I have no reason to run or hide.
Still you persist in this facade of loyalty?\n
Do you intend for your death to prove your\n
innocence?
Words are not necessary. My life belongs to the\n
imperial house... I remain loyal to Her Highness.
Laughable. And what do you believe can come of that?
Be you guilty or innocent, I have no reason to\n
pledge my loyalty to a girl as weak as she!
Vurai... have you gone mad...?\n
Such a statement is treachery to the throne...\n
Know your place!
Silence! Our glorious liege has passed on.\n
The powerless have no right to speak of lofty\n
ideals.
I have finally realized this. Yes...\n
Yamato can only be governed by one who wields\n
true power!
And so you would put yourself forth for the task...\n
Vurai.
No! The heavens alone decide who reigns supreme!\n
But a girl of such weakness will never be the\n
Mikado!
Oshtor, you shall understand that the truly strong\n
are the truly righteous!
With our liege gone, we must prove Yamato's\n
unwavering might! One so weak can never inherit\n
the throne!
Vurai... why? Why has a man like yourself--
Has our liege's death... twisted you so...?\n
Has such grief truly driven you to madness?
Call me a madman if you wish.\n
Your words have only rid me of all doubt.
My only course is to continue onward!
What... do you intend to do?
It matters not to you. You shall rot in this\n
prison. Without your Akuruka, you have no escape.
Do not think that you will ever see the sun's\n
light again.
Stop... Vurai! Are you--You dare to--\n
Her Highness--Nghh...!
Gah...! Hahh... hahh... hahh...
The moment Vurai's footsteps pass, a collective\n
exhale escapes the entire group.
Holy shit... that guy's scary as hell...
Damn... That guy's a monster!
Even just viewing him from afar makes my hair\n
stand on end...
Ahaha, you can let go of me now, Kuon...\n
I'll behave now.
I'd rather not have to go head-to-head against\n
a guy like that...
How long do you intend on keeping hold of me\n
like this?
Right, I forgot I was holding her back.
Oh, sorry.
Forgot it was a person I was holding onto\n
and not just some pillar...
...Rrrgh!
GYAGH!?
Haku!?
You need to keep your voice down...
Dear brother!
Nekone!?
Nekone jumps out from behind the pillar and\n
dashes toward Oshtor.
Shit!
What the--!? What was that simpering little\n
voice!?
How did--Where did you all come from!?
Uh-oh, looks like they found us...
That idiot...
We gotta move, boss! The little lady's in danger!
Dammit! Everyone, positions!
